scripts.test: bun test scripts && bun scripts/each.ts test
scripts.lint: oxlint packages examples demo scripts templates
scripts.format: oxfmt packages examples demo scripts templates
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check packages examples demo scripts templates
scripts.release: bun run build && bun run check && changeset publish
scripts.size: bun scripts/each.ts size && bun run --cwd bench size
